test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All sparrows are owls.

No sparrow is a parrot.

Conclusions:

(I): No owl is a parrot.

(II): No parrot is a sparrow.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f6f6cc709e3041dfe48aed48fd8ce62a85bc2a2b4c2251beecd51d839f29e8b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b8ac717c226f76e0af7b6ebdaa4c8d1ab3026b81896dc9205a3754906f7d4e4.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No owl is a parrot → Does not follow (As all sparrows are owls and no sparrow is a parrot. As no direct relation is given between owl and sparrow, therefore it is false)

(II) No parrot is a sparrow → **F**ollow (As no sparrow is a parrot. As no sparrow can be parrot, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
